text:
Maria Chen: Quick SEO check-in for the product launch + webinar next week. Need a short plan: keywords, schema (WebinarEvent + FAQ + Product), internal links from docs/blog, and redirects for renamed pages. Can we split and commit owners/dates?
Aj Patel: I'll take keyword mapping + on-page copy notes. Plan: primary + 3 secondaries per page, search intent, and meta templates. Will share spreadsheet by Fri.
Sara Gomez: I'll handle schema snippets and JSON-LD QA. Recommend WebinarEvent + VideoObject and FAQPage for the webinar post. Also will add structured data for product features.
Kevin Li: I'll map redirects. There are ~8 renamed docs from the migration last month that need 301s. Will create redirect rules and a Netlify/NGINX example.
Kevin Li: Example NGINX rule snippet: ```
# redirect old doc to new product page
rewrite ^/docs/old-product-guide/?$ /docs/new-product-guide/ permanent;
```
Tom O'Neill: For inbound leads: we need hidden UTM rules + form -> Salesforce routing. Who owns the GTM events? Also need to surface webinar registrants as MQLs.
Maria Chen: @Tom good call — add GTM tracking + form fields to task list. @Aj add UTM parameter examples in the spreadsheet.
Aj Patel: For keywords: landing page: "low-latency LLM inference" primary, secondary: "inference latency optimization", "LLM serving best practices", "GPU inference platform". Webinar page: "LLM serving webinar" + long-tail: "how to reduce inference cost", "inference retries and fallbacks".
Sara Gomez: JSON-LD draft for webinar (will publish to staging for QA): ```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Run LLMs in Production: latency, cost, and reliability",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T16:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/llm-inference" },
  "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.ai/register" }
}
```
Kevin Li: Redirect map I'll push to repo `marketing/redirects/llm-launch-2026.csv` with source,target,type. Include checks for 404s pre-launch.
Tom O'Neill: For lead routing: we need a single hidden field `source_campaign=llm_launch_apr26` and GTM to fire conversion event `webinar_reg`. SalesOps to pick up via SFDC flow.
Maria Chen: Owners & deadlines: Aj -> keywords spreadsheet by Fri (1751320967). Sara -> schema snippets + staging push by Mon (1751493767). Kevin -> redirect CSV + PR by EoW (1751310000). Tom -> GTM + form spec by Tue (1751390000). I'll collate and schedule a 30min review on Wed.
seo-bot: Reminder: run Lighthouse + Structured Data test on staging after schema is live.
Aj Patel: Also proposing internal linking plan: add links from: docs overview, product features, and relevant blog posts (performance benchmarks). I'll list anchor text suggestions in the sheet.
Sara Gomez: QA checklist: structured data validator, Google Rich Results test screenshot, and a sample SERP meta title/snippet preview.
Kevin Li: I'll set temporary redirects with 302 for testing, then swap to 301 after validation. Noted.
Tom O'Neill: One more ask — add form hidden field for `utm_content=benchmark_blog` when people come from the benchmark post.
Maria Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the launch task in Asana with these owners and link the spreadsheet + PRs. If anyone needs me to reassign, ping here. :rocket:
